comment.text: Label of the name input for a custom metadata field (a free field added to one item, outside any template), in the info panel.

usage.context:
<div className={styles.form}>
 <FieldContainer
 labelVisible
 isVertical
 removeMargin
 labelText={t("Metadata:CustomFieldName")}
 hasError={isNameTaken}
 errorMessage={t("Metadata:FieldNameExists")}
 >
 <TextInput
 type={InputType.text}

<div className={styles.newField}>
 <FieldContainer
 labelVisible
 isVertical
 removeMargin
 labelText={t("Metadata:CustomFieldName")}
 hasError={!!nameError}
 errorMessage={nameError}
 >
 <div className={styles.inputRow}>
 <TextInput
